text: Hino woodani ɓe ton, nafooje goo, hara wanaa waɗɗeteeɗi ɗin e ñaameteeji teew mum tun. Ɗum ko wano leeɓi baali ɗin, e leeɓi gelooɗi ɗin, e leeɓi be'i ɗin e coggeeli majji ɗin ɗi ɓe moƴƴinirta ndaɗɗudi e comci. Ɓe heɓoyay ton kadi, nooneeji njaram ka ɓe yaroyta kocce. E ɓee kan yettataa Alla neeminirɗo ɓe ɗii neemaaji ekw?
